label: PostgreSQL: run current file
command: docker exec -i typography_coursework_db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U ilyasemenov -d typography < "$ZED_FILE"

label: PostgreSQL: run current file from reader user
command: docker exec -e PGPASSWORD=stats_reader -i typography_coursework_db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U stats_reader -d typography < "$ZED_FILE"

label: PostgreSQL: run current file from source editor user
command: docker exec -e PGPASSWORD=source_editor -i typography_coursework_db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U source_editor -d typography < "$ZED_FILE"

label: PostgreSQL: run selected query
command: printf '%s\n' "$ZED_SELECTED_TEXT" | docker exec -i typography_coursework_db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U ilyasemenov -d typography
